recognize_zh: 抹片邊緣聚集數顆異常細胞，核深度摺疊或呈雙葉（蝴蝶狀），胞質含細小顆粒且較淡，缺乏正常的成熟嗜中性球分葉，符合低顆粒型急性前骨髓性白血病。
features: Small aggregate of medium to large immature cells at the edge of a red cell-dense area
Deeply folded, bilobed or lobulated nuclei with fine chromatin
Moderate pale cytoplasm with fine azurophilic granules
Background of normocytic red cells; few platelets visible
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a small aggregate of abnormal immature myeloid cells at the edge of a thicker area of the film. The cells are medium to large with moderate pale cytoplasm containing fine granules and deeply folded, bilobed or lobulated nuclei with fine chromatin. Auer rods are not clearly identified at this magnification, and platelets are sparse. Findings are consistent with the hypogranular (microgranular) variant of acute promyelocytic leukemia.

ddx.vs: Monocytic blasts show grey vacuolated cytoplasm and are NSE positive, whereas APL cells are strongly MPO positive and carry PML::RARA.
Dysplastic neutrophils have condensed mature chromatin and pink secondary cytoplasm, not fine immature chromatin.
Sezary cells have cerebriform nuclei with condensed chromatin and scant agranular cytoplasm rather than granular cytoplasm with fine chromatin.
